idea-plugin.name: Spring Helm Env Hints
idea-plugin.description:
Links Spring application*.yml|yaml configuration to the environment variables declared in Helm chart templates, with highlighting and two-way navigation. Env var occurrences are coloured differently depending on whether they exist on both sides (matched) or only one (unmatched), and an inline N refs tag is shown next to every env var that resolves to at least one occurrence on the opposite side — hover for the target file:line list, click to navigate.

Go to Declaration (Ctrl/Cmd+B) jumps Spring → Helm and Helm → Spring. Because Spring and Helm occurrences are registered as real PSI references, Ctrl+Click navigation and Refactor → Rename work across files as well.

Placeholders that reference a property of the same application*.yaml (url: ${app.host}:${app.port}) — or that the IDE itself already resolves — count as valid references: they are highlighted as matched instead of missing and navigate to the declaring key. Targets the IDE resolves on its own are merged in, so a key declared in several profile files (application-local.yml, …) offers every declaration.

Settings live under Settings → Other Settings → Spring Helm Env Hints: toggle Spring property key matching, switch to a project-wide scope, include folders excluded in the project structure, show or hide the N refs tag (including hiding it for a single reference), choose between background highlight and font colour with separate light/dark theme colours, and open a debug view that dumps the live index per scope as matched / Helm-only / Spring-only.
